justification: Inspected [JavadocCommentMetaModel.java](./javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/metamodel/JavadocCommentMetaModel.java), [JavaParserMetaModel.java](./javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/metamodel/JavaParserMetaModel.java), [JavadocComment.java](./javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/ast/comments/JavadocComment.java), and [MarkdownCommentMetaModel.java](./javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/metamodel/MarkdownCommentMetaModel.java). The target is a small generated wrapper that only depends on `CommentMetaModel` and `JavadocComment.class`, and I found only a few direct dependents: `JavaParserMetaModel` instantiates `javadocCommentMetaModel`, `JavadocComment` returns it from `getMetaModel()`, and `MarkdownCommentMetaModel` extends it. That is low fan-in/fan-out, so it does not show hub-like modularization.
